sequences.name: Post-Purchase Courtesy Offer
sequences.description: Reaches out to clients who passed on their post-purchase upgrade, offering a gentle second chance with a private courtesy discount.

steps.subject: A little courtesy for your recent order
steps.previewText: In case you still wanted to complete your ritual
steps.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Thank you again for your order {{order_number}}. We are already preparing everything for you.

When you checked out, you skipped the upgrade offer. In case you still wanted to add it to your routine, we saved a private 10% courtesy voucher for you:

Code: {{discount_code}}

You can review the offer and claim your discount here:
{{offer_url}}

No pressure at all—we simply wanted to make sure you had the option before your order ships.

Warmly,
The Jourvance Team

sequences.name: At-Risk Inactive Client Winback
sequences.description: Automatically re-engages clients who reach the at-risk inactivity threshold (90 days since last purchase) with a gentle check-in and 15% courtesy treat.

steps.subject: We miss you — a private 15% courtesy treat for your next ritual
steps.previewText: It's been a little while, and we'd love to welcome you back
steps.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

We noticed it’s been a little while since your last visit, and we wanted to check in.

Self-care should always feel effortless. To welcome you back, we’ve placed a special 15% courtesy reward on your profile for your next restock:

Use code {{discount_code}} at checkout.

Whenever you’re ready to replenish your favorites, we are here for you.

Warmly,
The Jourvance Team
